mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Federal Funds Rate above the prior month's level coincides with a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return due to higher discount rates eroding expected future equity cash flows.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above its previous month's value by more than 0.25 percentage points
failure_condition: Over a 12-month window, 20-day forward returns during FEDFUNDS upcross events are not statistically different from zero (p > 0.10), or the IC remains above 0.05 in all such windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in unemployment claims (PAYEMS) accompanied by a decline in hourly wage growth (HOUST) signals labor market weakness, which precedes a negative 60-day S&P 500 forward return as investor sentiment deteriorates.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > previous month by > 10,000 and HOUST < previous month
failure_condition: In regimes where unemployment rises and wages fall, the 60-day forward return is positive in >70% of such events (IC > 0.15), or the interaction is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive monthly decline in retail sales (GDPC1) exceeding 2% suggests weakening consumer demand, which predicts a negative 5-day S&P 500 forward return as investors anticipate lower corporate earnings.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 month-over-month decline > 2% for two consecutive months
failure_condition: During such demand contractions, the 5-day forward return is positive in >50% of cases (IC > 0.10), or the signal is not predictive in post-crisis periods (2020-2021).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) below the prior quarter's average, while inflation (CPIAUCSL) remains stable, indicates supply-side constraints that push up equity valuations and drive positive 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < previous quarter average and CPIAUCSL < previous quarter average
failure_condition: In supply-constrained episodes, the interaction is not significant (p > 0.10), or the 20-day forward return is not higher than the mean of the prior 30 such episodes (IC < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% for three consecutive months indicates a strong labor market, prompting the Federal Reserve to hold rates steady and supporting equity valuations, which predicts a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return.
failure_condition: During such periods, the 60-day forward return is negative in >50% of cases (IC > -0.10), or the signal loses predictive power in post-2008 expansions.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in monthly payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a sustained increase in consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 2% suggests wage-price misalignment, which precedes a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return as inflation expectations rise.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > previous month by > 20,000 and CPIAUCSL > 2% for two consecutive months
failure_condition: The interaction is not significant (p > 0.10), or the 20-day forward return is not consistently negative during such episodes (IC < -0.15).

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive monthly drop in retail sales (GDPC1) of more than 5% signals a deepening demand weakness, which persists for at least one quarter and reliably precedes a negative 60-day S&P 500 forward return.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 month-over-month decline > 5% for three consecutive months
failure_condition: During such prolonged declines, the 60-day forward return is not negative in >70% of episodes (IC < -0.20), or the signal reverts to noise after 2020 pandemic shock.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp and unexpected drop in industrial production (INDPRO) followed by a rapid recovery within the same month indicates temporary supply disruptions that are quickly resolved, which paradoxically supports near-term equity optimism and predicts a positive 5-day S&P 500 forward return.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO month-over-month drop > -10% followed by > 3% monthly rebound within the same month
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is not statistically higher than baseline during such episodes (IC < 0.05), or the pattern is not observed more than once every 12 months.
